# Feature: Bonus orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #20 (Bonus orb) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: optional, adds 10 seconds when taken. Unique: not needed for the gate, a large off-path time bank. Useful: a risk detour that pays for a slow main route. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** optional, adds 10 seconds when taken.

**So that** a risk detour that pays for a slow main route.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Bonus orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-20-bonus-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: a bonus orb down a short detour on a level with a tight timer. A player who takes the detour without counting discovers that the trip cost more than the ten seconds it repaid when the timer ends on the way back, which teaches that the bonus is a trade to be priced rather than a free reward. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Drawn with a gold ring, it is not counted in orbs-left and the gate does not need it
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Taking it adds 10 seconds to the timer immediately

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Bonus orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-20-bonus-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #20.
